title: Import your videos
subtitle: Bring your videos from YouTube or TikTok to 3Speak. Title, description, tags and thumbnail are filled in for you.
noChannel: You have not linked a YouTube channel yet. Link and verify it on your profile first, then come back here.
noVideos: No public videos found on this channel.

progress.transfer: Loading the video into the uploader: {{pct}}%

fallback.intro: You can still import it: download the video yourself and pick the file here. Everything else stays filled in.
fallback.step2: Click the three dots menu and choose Download.

errors.signIn: Sign in to import your videos.
errors.blocked: YouTube did not let our server download this video right now.
errors.notVideo: That file is not a video.
errors.tooLongForShort: This video is longer than {{minutes}} minutes, too long for a Short. Import it as a regular video instead.

empty.videos: No public videos on this channel.
empty.shorts: No public Shorts on this channel.
empty.live: No past livestreams on this channel.

limits: Imports are limited to videos up to {{minutes}} minutes, in up to {{height}}p.
premiumHint: With 3Speak Premium you can import in up to {{height}}p.

tiktok.noLink: You have not linked a TikTok account yet. Link and verify it on your profile first, then come back here.
tiktok.pasteLabel: Import any of your TikToks with its link
tiktok.pasteHint: Works for every video on your account, also older ones. Share links like vm.tiktok.com work too.
tiktok.fallbackStep1: Open the video in the TikTok app.
tiktok.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?
tiktok.empty: No public TikToks found on your account.

instagram.noLink: You have not linked a Instagram account yet. Link and verify it on your profile first, then come back here.
instagram.pasteLabel: Import any of your Instagram videos with its link
instagram.pasteHint: Works for every reel and video post on your account, also older ones. Copy the link from Share → Copy link.
instagram.fallbackStep1: Open the video in the Instagram app.
instagram.empty: No public videos found among your newest Instagram posts.
instagram.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?

batch.maxReached: You can pick up to {{max}} videos at once
batch.busy: Your previous batch is still being imported
batch.formIntro: Titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnails come from each video. These settings apply to all of them.
batch.lockedNote: 3Speak adds its usual share on top: 10% to @threespeakfund and 1% for encoding (3Speak Premium members skip these).
batch.spacing: Each video is imported on our server and then published on its own, {{minutes}} minutes apart. The first goes out a few minutes after it is ready. You can close this page.
batch.grantNeeded: To publish while you are away, 3Speak needs permission to post for your account. You can remove it any time in your Hive wallet.
batch.grantPending: Your wallet signed it, but the blockchain does not show it yet. Try again in a moment.

bitchute.noLink: You have not linked a BitChute account yet. Link and verify it on your profile first, then come back here.
bitchute.pasteLabel: Import any of your BitChute videos with its link
bitchute.pasteHint: Works for every video on your channel. Copy the link from the video's page.
bitchute.fallbackStep2: Download the original file from your BitChute account.
bitchute.empty: No public videos found on your BitChute channel.
bitchute.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?

rumble.noLink: You have not linked a Rumble account yet. Link and verify it on your profile first, then come back here.
rumble.pasteLabel: Import any of your Rumble videos with its link
rumble.pasteHint: Works for every video on your channel. Copy the link from the video's page.
rumble.fallbackStep2: Download the original file from your Rumble account.
rumble.empty: No public videos found on your Rumble channel.
rumble.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?
